In the  Court of the Sessions Judge,Araria.
AB.P. NO. 1950/2020
Arising out of Tarabari  P.S. case no.108/2020   
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------                
Mannan and 6 others
                               Petitioner.
Versus
           State of Bihar 
                     Opposite Party
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------     
Appearance:       
For the petitioners:    
Mr. M.Hussain,Advocate                                    
       
 For the prosecution:   Mr. L.N.Yadav,P.P.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
       
This anticipatory bail petition  filed on behalf of accused petitioners
namely 1. Mannan 2. Pappu @ Asad 3. Noman 4. Babloo 5. Daraksha 6. Kousar
Khatoon and 7. Sabra  who apprehend their arrest in connection with Tarabari P.S. case
no. 108/2020 u/s 147,149,341,323,324,354,379,504,506,427 I.P.C pressed today by his
learned counsel.  
Heard both the sides in physical  mode of court proceeding. 
The learned counsel for the accused petitioners submits  that the accused
petitioners is  innocent who has been falsely implicated in this case due to previous
enmity  and all the offences are bailable except 354 and 379 I.P.C. which are  general and
super addition. There is prior enemical terms running between the parties and the
petitioner Darkhasah has also lodged Tarabari P.S. case no. 104/2020 against the
informant and others, hence petitioner deserves to be released on  anticipatory bail. 
The learned  P.P.  opposed the anticipatory bail petition. 
Heard the  submissions  of both the sides and perused the L.C.R..
Prosecution case as per F.I.R. being fard bayan of informant Md. Samim briefly is that
all the 7 petitioners alongwith co-accused Asfaque on dated 16.10.2020 at 10 a.m.
forming an unlawful assembly having common object came at the house of informant
and abused and assaulted to informant and also broke the Tati of courtyard. It has been
alleged further that petitioner no. 1 Mannan has inflicted farsa injury on the head of
informant and when informant's sister Furiya Khatoon came there, accused persons
have also assaulted to Furiya by lathi stroke. There is further allegation that accused
persons have committed theft of Rs. 50,000/- cash and Jewelery and ran away seeing the
neighbouring persons rushed on the spot. 
As per submission of the petitioners for having counter allegation against
the informant of this case vide Tarabari P.S. case no. 104/2020 lodged by petitioner
Darkasha Parween for having prior enemical dispute between both the sides, it
transpires that on the alleged date time and place members of both the family came in
clash and confrontation and exchanged assault to each other, therefore, allegation of
theft and molestation as alleged appears super addition and rest sections of I.P.C. are of
bailable in nature. Therefore, in the given facts and circumstances, I find it is a fit case to
grant anticipatory bail. Accordingly, anticipatory bail prayer of the petitioners is
allowed. In the event of their arrest or surrender before the court below within a period
of four weeks from receipt of this order the petitioners shall be released on bail on
furnishing their bail bonds of Rs. 10,000/- with two sureties of like amount each to the
satisfaction of the court below subject to the conditions as laid down u/s 438(2) Cr.p.C.
(Dictated)
sd/-
  (P.K.Dixit) 
    Sessions Judge
07.01.2021
